text: Core courses Film Language, Broadcasting and Anchoring, Journalism News Collection and Writing, Telephotography, TV Film Editing, TV Editing, and Computer Design. Objective This objective is to train students to raise high political consciousness, nurish theory accomplishments, reach the high quality of news and obtain artistic ability. After graduation, students will be able to work as radio or television editors, correspondents, cameramen, TV hosts, and professional TV and Radio producers and planners in broadcast & TV units, media and publicity & culture departments. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 190 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Arts is granted
